name: Benchmark databases of noncovalent interaction energies
description: Provides curated benchmark interaction-energy databases for noncovalent complexes to assess and validate computational chemistry methods.
evaluation_method: MAE / RMSE (mean absolute error / root mean squared error) typically reported against high-level reference values
typical_sota_score: 0.05–0.5 kcal/mol (MAE) depending on method and subset
reputation: Widely regarded in the quantum chemistry community as gold‑standard reference sets for validating noncovalent interaction methods (e.g., S22, S66).
notes: High-quality, small benchmark sets (not large-scale ML training corpora); risk of overfitting/saturation for methods tuned to these sets; heterogeneous reference levels across different databases; non‑LLM benchmark.
